description: Adam Letchford and Juan-Jose Salazar-Gonzalez publish 240 capacitated vehicle-routing instances used to evaluate stronger bounds in pseudo-polynomial time. Each instance contains 15 customers and one depot. The benchmark varies symmetric versus asymmetric distances, unit versus general customer demands and vehicle capacity. Unit-demand cases use capacities of 4, 6 or 8; general-demand cases use 100, 150 or 200. These synthetic instances support optimisation and comparison of freight vehicle-routing methods. They do not represent an identified operational road network or observed delivery service. The public Mendeley record identifies University of La Laguna as the repository and provides TSPLIB95 text files under CC BY 4.0 without a stated charge. Version 1 was published in June 2018. No observation period, physical geographic location or time resolution applies to the described static benchmarks. The supporting article is DOI 10.1016/j.ejor.2018.06.002; it is not the dataset identity. Update frequency and field-level validation are not stated. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
